settings.heading: Shipping Options
settings.text: MPD ships internationally to 70+ countries using the Government of India postal service or DHL, depending on service availability in your country.

settings.heading: Payment Methods
settings.text: We accept all international debit and credit cards, as well as PayPal.

settings.heading: Customs Fees
settings.text: Please note that additional charges, such as customs handling fees, import duties, or other taxes, may apply based on your country's regulations. These fees will be solely the responsibility of the customer.

settings.heading: Placing an Order
settings.text: You can place an order directly on our website, or you can fill out the form below to request assistance for placing your order.

settings.heading: Delivery Time
settings.text: Delivery typically takes 7-15 business days, depending on your exact location.
